articles.title: Offerings Management
articles.summary:
Manage healthcare service offerings and packages

Create service packages, set pricing, and manage what your practice offers to patients.
articles.content:
**Managing Healthcare Offerings:**

**What are Offerings?**
Offerings are healthcare services, packages, or programs your practice provides to patients. Examples:
• Annual Wellness Package
• Executive Physical
• Weight Management Program
• Chronic Care Management
• Sports Physical
• Travel Medicine Consultation
• Concierge Medicine Membership

**Accessing Offerings:**
1. Go to Administration module
2. Click 'Healthcare Offerings'
3. View all active offerings
4. Click '+ New Offering' to create

**Creating New Offering:**

Step 1: Basic Information
• Offering Name (e.g., "Annual Wellness Package")
• Category:
  - Preventive Care
  - Chronic Disease Management
  - Specialty Services
  - Membership Programs
  - Wellness Programs
  - Diagnostic Services
• Description (patient-facing, marketing copy)
• Internal Notes (staff-only information)

Step 2: Services Included
Select what's included in offering:
• Office visits (quantity and type)
• Lab tests (specific tests)
• Imaging studies
• Procedures
• Vaccinations
• Counseling sessions
• Follow-up calls/check-ins
• Portal messaging access
• After-hours availability

**Example - Annual Wellness Package:**
✓ 1 Comprehensive Physical Exam (60 min)
✓ Comprehensive Metabolic Panel (CMP)
✓ Lipid Panel
✓ HbA1c Test
✓ Thyroid Panel (TSH, T4)
✓ Urinalysis
✓ EKG
✓ Health Risk Assessment
✓ Nutrition Counseling (30 min)
✓ Personalized Wellness Plan
✓ 1 Follow-up Visit (30 min)

Step 3: Pricing
• Standard Price (full retail)
• Member Price (if applicable)
• Insurance Billable (yes/no)
• Payment Options:
  - One-time payment
  - Monthly installments
  - Annual subscription
• Tax Treatment (taxable/non-taxable)

Step 4: Eligibility & Requirements
• Age Range (e.g., 18-64, 65+)
• Gender (All, Male, Female)
• Patient Type (New, Established, All)
• Prerequisites (e.g., must complete health assessment)
• Exclusions (contraindications)

Step 5: Scheduling
• Can be scheduled online (yes/no)
• Required appointment duration
• Specific providers only (or all)
• Specific locations (if multi-site)
• Advance booking window (e.g., 7-90 days)

Step 6: Marketing & Display
• Display on patient portal (yes/no)
• Display on website (yes/no)
• Featured offering (highlighted)
• Upload images/brochure
• SEO keywords
• Call-to-action text

**Managing Existing Offerings:**

**Editing:**
1. Click offering from list
2. Click 'Edit'
3. Update any fields
4. Click 'Save Changes'
5. Changes effective immediately

**Activating/Deactivating:**
1. Toggle 'Active' switch
2. Active = Available for booking
3. Inactive = Hidden from patients, existing enrolled continue

**Archiving:**
1. Click 'Archive' on offering
2. Archived offerings not bookable
3. Existing enrollments handled per policy:
   • Complete existing
   • Refund prorated
   • Transfer to similar offering

**Patient Enrollment:**

**Enrolling Patients:**
1. Open patient chart
2. Go to 'Offerings' tab
3. Click '+ Enroll in Offering'
4. Select offering from dropdown
5. Choose payment plan
6. Set start date
7. Apply any discounts
8. Process payment or send invoice
9. Generate enrollment agreement
10. Patient signs consent

**Enrollment Status:**
• Pending - Enrollment requested, awaiting payment
• Active - Currently enrolled
• Paused - Temporarily suspended
• Completed - Offering period finished
• Cancelled - Enrollment cancelled
• Expired - Enrollment term ended

**Managing Enrollments:**

**Viewing Enrollments:**
1. Go to Healthcare Offerings
2. Click specific offering
3. View 'Enrollments' tab
4. See all patients enrolled
5. Filter by status, date, provider

**Tracking Usage:**
For each enrollment:
• Services used vs. included
• Appointments scheduled/completed
• Tests ordered/completed
• Next scheduled services
• Remaining balance (visits, tests)
• Renewal date

**Example Tracking:**
John Doe - Annual Wellness Package
✓ Physical Exam (completed 1/1/2025)
✓ CMP (completed 1/1/2025)
✓ Lipid Panel (completed 1/1/2025)
⏳ Nutrition Counseling (scheduled 2/1/2025)
☐ Follow-up Visit (not scheduled - 0/1 used)

**Renewal Management:**

**Auto-Renewal Settings:**
1. Edit offering
2. Enable 'Auto-renewal'
3. Set renewal terms:
   • 30 days before expiration
   • Automatic billing
   • Notification to patient
   • Opt-out window

**Manual Renewal:**
1. System notifies 60 days before expiration
2. Staff contacts patient
3. Update offering if changed
4. Process renewal payment
5. Extend enrollment period

**Reporting & Analytics:**

**Available Reports:**
• Enrollment by Offering
• Revenue by Offering
• Most Popular Offerings
• Completion Rates
• Renewal Rates
• Patient Demographics by Offering
• Service Utilization
• Average Revenue per Patient
• Cancellation Reasons

**Marketing Integration:**

**Promoting Offerings:**
• Email campaigns to patient list
• Portal announcements
• In-office signage/brochures
• Website landing pages
• Social media posts
• Seasonal promotions

**Discount Codes:**
1. Create promo codes
2. Set discount amount/percentage
3. Set expiration date
4. Apply to specific offerings
5. Track redemptions

**Membership Programs:**

**Creating Memberships:**
Special type of offering with:
• Monthly or annual fee
• Ongoing benefits (not one-time)
• Automatic renewal
• Tiered levels (Basic, Premium, VIP)

**Example - Concierge Membership:**
Premium Level - $200/month:
• Same/next-day appointments
• Direct provider cell phone access
• Extended 45-min appointments
• No copays for visits
• Annual physical included
• 24/7 telehealth access
• Prescription discounts
• Quarterly wellness coaching

**Best Practices:**
• Price competitively based on market research
• Bundle complementary services
• Clear descriptions of what's included
• Update offerings based on patient feedback
• Track utilization to optimize bundles
• Promote preventive care packages
• Offer payment plans for expensive packages
• Set realistic appointment durations
• Train staff on all offerings
• Review and update quarterly
• Use offerings for patient retention
• Create seasonal offerings (flu season, sports physicals)
• Ensure HIPAA compliance in marketing
• Get legal review for membership agreements

articles.title: Campaigns Management
articles.summary:
Create and manage patient marketing campaigns

Send targeted email and SMS campaigns to specific patient segments for appointments, wellness, and engagement.
articles.content:
**Managing Marketing Campaigns:**

**What are Campaigns?**
Campaigns are targeted communications to specific patient groups via email, SMS, or portal. Common uses:
• Appointment reminders
• Wellness program promotion
• Preventive care outreach (flu shots, annual physicals)
• New service announcements
• Patient education
• Re-engagement of inactive patients
• Birthday/holiday greetings
• Patient satisfaction surveys

**Accessing Campaigns:**
1. Go to Marketing module
2. Click 'Campaigns'
3. View active, scheduled, and past campaigns
4. Click '+ New Campaign' to create

**Creating New Campaign:**

Step 1: Campaign Basics
• Campaign Name (internal, e.g., "2025 Flu Shot Outreach")
• Campaign Type:
  - Appointment Reminder
  - Wellness Promotion
  - Re-engagement
  - Educational
  - Promotional
  - Survey/Feedback
• Description/Goal
• Start and End Dates

Step 2: Target Audience

**Patient Segmentation:**
Create filters to target specific patients:

**Demographics:**
• Age range (e.g., 65+ for Medicare wellness)
• Gender
• Location/zip code
• Language preference

**Clinical:**
• Specific diagnoses (e.g., diabetics for A1C reminder)
• Medications (e.g., warfarin patients for INR)
• Last visit date (e.g., >12 months for re-engagement)
• Overdue preventive care
• Lab results in range

**Behavioral:**
• Portal users vs. non-users
• Appointment no-show history
• Payment history
• Enrollment in programs/offerings

**Example Segments:**

**Flu Shot Campaign:**
• Age 50+ OR high-risk conditions
• No flu vaccine current season
• Active patients (visit in last 24 months)

**Diabetic A1C Reminder:**
• Diagnosis: Diabetes (ICD E11.9)
• Last A1C >90 days ago
• Active patients

**Re-engagement:**
• No visit in 18+ months
• Previously active (3+ visits historically)
• Age 18-75
• Not deceased or moved

Step 3: Message Creation

**Channel Selection:**
☑️ Email
☑️ SMS/Text
☑️ Portal Message
☐ Phone Call (manual)
☐ Postcard (mail)

**Email Message:**
1. Subject Line (compelling, clear)
2. Preview Text (appears in inbox)
3. Email Body:
   • Use template or create custom
   • Rich text editor with formatting
   • Insert merge fields (patient name, provider)
   • Add images/logos
   • Include call-to-action button
   • Add unsubscribe link (required)
4. Mobile-responsive design

**SMS Message:**
1. Limited to 160 characters
2. Clear, concise message
3. Include opt-out instructions (STOP)
4. Insert merge fields
5. Optional link (use URL shortener)

**Merge Fields:**
Personalize messages:
• {{FirstName}}
• {{LastName}}
• {{PreferredName}}
• {{ProviderName}}
• {{ClinicName}}
• {{NextAppointment}}
• {{LastVisitDate}}

**Example Messages:**

**Email - Flu Shot:**
Subject: Protect Yourself This Flu Season, {{FirstName}}!

Hi {{FirstName}},

Flu season is here! Protect yourself and your loved ones with a flu vaccine.

✓ Quick and convenient
✓ No appointment needed
✓ Walk-ins welcome Mon-Fri 9am-5pm
✓ Most insurance covers 100%

[Schedule Your Flu Shot]

Questions? Call us at (555) 123-4567.

Stay healthy,
{{ClinicName}} Team

**SMS - Appointment Reminder:**
"Hi {{FirstName}}! Reminder: You have an appt with Dr. {{ProviderName}} tomorrow at {{AppointmentTime}}. Reply C to confirm or R to reschedule. Reply STOP to opt out."

Step 4: Scheduling

**Send Options:**
• Send Now - Immediate delivery
• Schedule - Specific date/time
• Recurring - Repeat campaign
• Drip Campaign - Sequence over time

**Best Send Times:**
• Email: Tuesday-Thursday 10am-2pm
• SMS: 10am-6pm (avoid early morning/late evening)
• Avoid Mondays and Fridays
• Consider time zones

**Frequency Limits:**
Set rules to prevent over-messaging:
• Max 1 promotional email per week
• Max 2 SMS per month
• Exclude patients who opted out
• Respect quiet hours (9pm-9am)

Step 5: Compliance & Consent

**HIPAA Compliance:**
• Only use secure, encrypted channels
• Don't include PHI in subject lines
• Limit clinical details in messages
• Audit trail for all communications
• Patient consent documented

**Consent Requirements:**
• Email: Implied for existing patients
• SMS: Explicit opt-in required
• Marketing: Can opt-out anytime
• Appointment reminders: Different rules (operational)

**Opt-Out Management:**
• Automatic opt-out processing
• "Reply STOP" for SMS
• Unsubscribe link for email
• Remove from future campaigns
• Document opt-out date

Step 6: Review and Launch

**Pre-Launch Checklist:**
✓ Target audience count reasonable
✓ Message proofread (no typos)
✓ Merge fields tested
✓ Links work correctly
✓ Mobile preview checked
✓ Unsubscribe link present
✓ Compliance verified
✓ Approval obtained (if required)

**Test Campaign:**
1. Send to test group (staff emails)
2. Verify formatting
3. Check links
4. Test on mobile devices
5. Confirm deliverability

**Launch:**
1. Final review
2. Click 'Launch Campaign'
3. System begins sending
4. Monitor real-time progress

**Monitoring Campaign Performance:**

**Real-Time Metrics:**
• Total sent
• Delivery rate
• Open rate (email)
• Click-through rate
• Bounce rate
• Unsubscribe rate
• Conversion rate (appointments booked)

**Email Metrics:**
• Sent: 1,000
• Delivered: 980 (98%)
• Opened: 392 (40%)
• Clicked: 98 (10%)
• Bounced: 20 (2%)
• Unsubscribed: 5 (0.5%)
• Appointments Booked: 45 (4.6% conversion)

**SMS Metrics:**
• Sent: 500
• Delivered: 495 (99%)
• Clicked: 125 (25%)
• Opt-outs: 2 (0.4%)
• Responses: 87 (17.4%)

**Post-Campaign Analysis:**

**Available Reports:**
• Campaign Performance Summary
• Audience Engagement by Segment
• ROI Analysis (cost vs. revenue generated)
• Bounce Analysis (update contact info)
• A/B Test Results
• Time-of-Day Performance
• Device Breakdown (mobile vs. desktop)

**Drip Campaigns:**

**What are Drip Campaigns?**
Automated series of messages over time.

**Example - New Patient Onboarding:**
• Day 1: Welcome email with portal setup
• Day 3: SMS reminder to complete health history
• Day 7: Email about services and offerings
• Day 14: Survey about first visit experience
• Day 30: Email about preventive care schedule

**Example - Chronic Care Management:**
• Week 1: Educational content about condition
• Week 2: Medication adherence tips
• Week 3: Lifestyle modification resources
• Week 4: Schedule follow-up appointment
• Repeat monthly with new content

**A/B Testing:**

**Testing Variables:**
• Subject lines
• Send times
• Message length
• Call-to-action wording
• Images vs. text-only
• Sender name

**How to A/B Test:**
1. Create two versions (A and B)
2. Split audience 50/50
3. Send simultaneously
4. Compare performance
5. Use winner for future campaigns

**Campaign Templates:**

**Pre-Built Templates:**
• Annual Physical Reminder
• Flu Shot Promotion
• Appointment Reminder
• Birthday Wishes
• Patient Satisfaction Survey
• New Service Announcement
• Insurance Information Update
• Portal Registration Invitation

**Creating Custom Templates:**
1. Design message
2. Add merge fields
3. Save as template
4. Reuse for future campaigns
5. Update as needed

**Budget & Cost Tracking:**

**Campaign Costs:**
• SMS: ~$0.01-0.03 per message
• Email: ~$0.001 per email (or unlimited)
• Design/copywriting time
• Tool/platform fees

**ROI Calculation:**
• Revenue generated (appointments booked)
• Minus campaign costs
• Equals ROI

**Example:**
Flu Shot Campaign:
• Cost: $50 (500 SMS × $0.10)
• Appointments booked: 75
• Revenue: $1,875 (75 × $25)
• ROI: 3,650%

**Best Practices:**
• Segment audiences for relevance
• Personalize messages with merge fields
• Clear call-to-action in every message
• Mobile-first design
• Test before launching
• Monitor deliverability rates
• Clean contact lists regularly
• Respect frequency limits
• Always include opt-out
• Track ROI on every campaign
• Use templates for consistency
• A/B test to optimize
• Comply with HIPAA and TCPA
• Get consent for SMS
• Schedule at optimal times
• Follow up on engagement
• Update based on performance data
• Coordinate with front desk on responses
